Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

content:
--********************************************************************--
-- Author:              zongyi.lu@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2024-03-11
-- Theme Domain：       mp order 
-- Description:         risk mp order, https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/11Bpx701mGtwTHd0-TXZE5ickY4HHPFsVCnsui_cWuUM/edit#gid=400549880
-- Data Granularity:    
-- 变更历史：
-- update by zongyi.lu@shopee 2024-10-30 新增字段 payment_method_id,has_return_item,is_net_order,payment_channel
--********************************************************************--


drop table if exists ${SCHEMA}.dwd_risk_${region}_user_txn_mp_order_complete_df;
create external table if not exists ${SCHEMA}.dwd_risk_${region}_user_txn_mp_order_complete_df
(
platform_user_id                   string               comment 'platform_user_id - shopee_user_id'
,seller_user_id                    string               comment 'seller_user_id - shopee_user_id'
,order_id                          bigint               comment 'order_id'
,gmv                               bigint               comment 'gmv'
,gmv_usd                           bigint               comment 'gmv_usd'
,shop_id                           bigint               comment 'shop_id'
,checkout_id                       bigint               comment 'checkout_id'
,payment_be_channel                string               comment 'payment_be_channel'  
,order_be_status_id                bigint               comment 'order_be_status_id "4 → completed, 11 → escrow paid, 12 → escrow created, 13 → escrow pending, 14 → escrow verified, 15 → escrow payout"'  
,buyer_shipping_address_district   string               comment 'property@buyer shipping district'  
,buyer_shipping_address_town       string               comment 'property@buyer shipping town'
,escrow_paid_datetime              string               comment 'escrow paid datetime'
,shipping_confirm_timestamp        bigint               comment 'property@shipping confirm timestamp. For cash on delivery (COD) order: time when the order is placed. For non-COD order: time when the order is paid' 
,shipping_confirm_time_local       string               comment 'property@shipping confirm timestamp. For cash on delivery (COD) order: time when the order is placed. For non-COD order: time when the order is paid'  
,is_bi_excluded                    bigint               comment 'tag@is_bi excluded'  
,payment_method_id                 bigint               comment 'property@payment method id, this is roughly detail of backend payment channel; refer: dim_payment_method for enum value'
,has_return_item                   tinyint              comment 'tag@whether has any item been returned'
,is_net_order                      tinyint              comment 'tag@Whether the order is a net order, this is calculated based on the order, refer to user guide for more details(https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NkpDYLikLCRliJubXTbK3GXpLxa-0-G03Ud5OaX0rWI/edit#heading=h.b8cth4bt3s42), starts from 2020-01-01'
,payment_channel                   string               comment 'property@payment channel name, this is same thing with backend payment channel. But it is alias'
,payment_be_channel_id             bigint               comment 'property@backend payment channel id, it has 1-1 mapping with spm_channel_id and options. For example, shopee pay later will have 3,6 and 9 months installment. Each installment has same spm_channel_id, but has different backend payment channel id. refer:dim_payment_channel__reg_live for enum value'
)
partitioned by
(
    grass_date     string   comment "YYYY-MM-DD"
)
stored as orc tblproperties ("orc.compress"="zstd")
location '${HDFS_PATH}/risk_feature/dwd/dwd_risk_aio_user_txn_mp_order_complete_df/garss_region=${grass_region}';
msck repair table ${SCHEMA}.dwd_risk_${region}_user_txn_mp_order_complete_df;

add jar hdfs://R2/projects/credit/hdfs/udf/hive-udf.jar;
drop temporary function if exists format_time; 
create temporary function format_time as 'com.shopee.seamoney.udf.FromTimeStamp';


insert overwrite table ${SCHEMA}.dwd_risk_${region}_user_txn_mp_order_complete_df partition(grass_date)
select 
t1.buyer_id                                                    as platform_user_id
,t1.seller_id                                                  as seller_user_id
,t1.order_id                                                   as order_id
,t1.gmv                                                        as gmv
,t1.gmv_usd                                                    as gmv_usd
,t1.shop_id                                                    as shop_id
,t1.checkout_id                                                as checkout_id
,t1.payment_be_channel                                         as payment_be_channel
,t1.order_be_status_id                                         as order_be_status_id
,t1.buyer_shipping_address_district                            as buyer_shipping_address_district
,t1.buyer_shipping_address_town                                as buyer_shipping_address_town
,t1.escrow_paid_datetime                                       as escrow_paid_datetime
,t1.shipping_confirm_timestamp                                 as shipping_confirm_timestamp
,format_time(t1.shipping_confirm_timestamp,upper('${region}')) as shipping_confirm_time_local
,t1.is_bi_excluded                                             as is_bi_excluded
,t1.payment_method_id                                          as payment_method_id 
,t1.has_return_item                                            as has_return_item     
,t1.is_net_order                                               as is_net_order  
,t1.payment_channel                                            as payment_channel  
,t1.payment_be_channel_id                                      as payment_be_channel_id  
,'${grass_date}'                                               as grass_date
